Determines whether DNS records for api, api-int, and ingress are provided by the internal DNS service or externally. When set to 'Internal' (or omitted), records are provided by the internal infrastructure. When set to 'External', records must be configured by the user on a DNS server outside the cluster; External requires the OnPremDNSRecords feature gate to be enabled and loadBalancer.type=UserManaged. External mode is not currently configured by this application.
parameters.notes: Cataloged for documentation completeness. The OnPremDNSRecords feature gate can be enabled via TechPreviewNoUpgrade, DevPreviewNoUpgrade, or CustomNoUpgrade with an explicit featureGates entry. External mode also requires loadBalancer.type=UserManaged. This application omits the field entirely (defaulting to Internal) because it does not configure the required feature gate or loadBalancer.type selection.

Global OS image stream for every machine in the cluster. NOT EXPOSED by OpenShift Airgap Architect and never emitted. New at OpenShift 4.22 and gated by the OSStreams feature gate, which openshift/api enables only under TechPreviewNoUpgrade or DevPreviewNoUpgrade; openshift-install 4.22.16 rejects the field outright without that feature set. Red Hat documents RHEL 10 as a Technology Preview base image at 4.22, and Technology Preview is not covered by production service level agreements, so this is recorded for provenance rather than offered as a choice.
parameters.versionNotes: Introduced at 4.22 (pkg/types/installconfig.go InstallConfig.OSImageStream, enum rhel-9|rhel-10). Binary-verified rejection: "Forbidden: this field is protected by the OSStreams feature gate which must be enabled through either the TechPreviewNoUpgrade or CustomNoUpgrade feature set". Architect does not offer TechPreviewNoUpgrade, so emitting this field could only ever produce a rejected install-config. rhel-10 is additionally forbidden on SCOS/OKD builds.

Binary-verified rejection: "controlPlane.management: Forbidden: this field is protected by the ClusterAPIControlPlaneInstall feature gate". The gate fires only when the value is explicitly set; an omitted field defaults to ClusterAPI later in the pipeline without tripping it, so omitting is both correct and safe. The installer doc comment says "Supported platforms: aws".
